label: a6r6-rem-rn-conventions-and-scope
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Checked dimension boundaries (n=0, n≥1, m≥1) across all cited items; the target correctly reports which items carry the restriction and where n=0 is handled separately. Verified that the rational‑exponent restriction is accurate and no supplied item uses a real exponent interval. The identification of ℝ¹ with ℝ via an isometric bijection is stated where comparisons are made. The containment‑only nature of the rearrangement theorem is explicitly declared in that theorem, matching the target’s description. No counterexample found to any factual assertion.

SOURCES: Inspected all 31 supplied items. Confirmed that lem‑metrics‑on‑rn defines the metrics only for n≥1; that items listed as carrying no dimension hypothesis indeed do not (or only in specific clauses as noted); that items listed as carrying n≥1 or m≥1 state it in their Statement; that def‑rational‑power, def‑p‑norms‑on‑rn, and thm‑minkowski‑finite use rational exponents; that comparisons to the one‑dimensional theory explicitly employ θ; and that thm‑rearrangement‑sums‑lie‑in‑an‑affine‑subspace claims only containment.

CHECKED: Verified the title, the complete public statement (all six sections), every numbered claim, and the remarks throughout. No false statements, no invalid inferences, no missing hypotheses. The item accurately describes the conventions, scope, and reading‑order status of the page.
